SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.thumbnail_img AS thumbnail_img, MIN(v.price) AS min_price, p.rating AS rating, p.sold_count AS sold_count FROM products p INNER JOIN product_variants v ON p.id = v.product_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND LOWER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{request.keyword}), '%')
AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT id FROM category_tree )
AND p.shop_id = #{request.shopId} AND p.rating >= #{request.minRating}
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.thumbnail_img, p.rating, p.sold_count, p.created_at
HAVING 1 = 1 AND MIN(v.price) >= #{request.minPrice} AND MIN(v.price) <= #{request.maxPrice}
ORDER BY MIN(v.price) ASC
ORDER BY MIN(v.price) DESC
ORDER BY p.rating DESC
ORDER BY p.sold_count DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
